alignments.note: Vocative divine name with its supplied *O* (rule 36).

Prepositional predicate of a verbless clause: the supplied linking verb *endureth* stands where a copula would stand and joins the preposition's unit, headed on the preposition (rules 20 and 49). The competing reading marks *endureth* `added` as a supplied lexical verb; it adds no participant the Hebrew does not write, so it is read as the copula.
Noun with the generic *name* the ASV supplies to complete the expression; the supplied noun joins its unit and the head stays on the word carrying the lexeme (rule 31).
Vocative divine name with its supplied *O* (rule 36).
First occurrence of the distributive repetition takes the noun's English together with the supplied quantifying determiner (rules 22 and 15).
Waw of the distributive repetition, for which the ASV writes no connective (rules 14 and 22).
Repeated occurrence the ASV renders once (rule 22).

review_notes: *endureth* is read as the construction's linking verb on the prepositional predicate rather than as an `added` lexical verb; both readings were weighed and the copula reading is named in the unit's note.
`לְדֹר וָדֹר` is a distributive repetition rendered once, so the first occurrence carries *all generations* and the waw and second noun go `unrepresented`.
